gap: No result ChatGPT got states which parking-mode hardwire kit fits each 4-channel camera and what the pair costs: the Rexing R4-RD ships with its kit at $279.99, the Botslab G980H 4-channel needs a separate Type-C kit from $35.99, and the Vantrue N5S at $293.99 goes over $300 once a Vantrue kit ($24.99 to $34.99) is added.
standout_why: Compared against three results. Our own page (dealectric.com/best-4-channel-dash-cam, read 2026-11-21) says the R4-RD kit is included and the N5S kit is 'sold separately', but gives no kit model, price or voltage range, and lists the Botslab only under 'Not recommended' with no price. Dashlore's guide (read 2026-11-21) covers only the N5S and says 'Parking mode needs a hardwire kit, sold separately' with no model or price; it also says 'LTE needs an add-on 4G module' without a price. The rexing.com R4-RD listing says 'Smart Hardwire Kit Included' but not that Rexing's separate 360° motion kit excludes the R4-RD. None gives a camera-plus-kit total against the $300 line or the hybrid/EV exclusion. Not compared: Tom's Guide came back truncated with no 4-channel content visible, Best Buy timed out, and I did not open the winchinsider, pwice, modelrec, techsmagazine, dattatecblog, my-best, productbible, roadgearlab or saltandolive pages.
decides: It splits the answer by whether the shopper wants parking recording. With parking mode, three setups stay under $300 on the prices read: Rexing R4-RD ($279.99, kit in the box), Botslab G980H 4-channel plus its $35.99 kit, and REDTIGER VisionPano 40 ($199.49) plus REDTIGER's $35.99 kit. The Vantrue N5S ($293.99) fits the budget only as a camera; with any Vantrue kit it lands between $318.98 and $328.98, and the kit Vantrue names for the 'N5 S' in its title ($29.99) makes it $323.98. The older Vantrue Nexus 5 ($265.99) plus that $29.99 kit is $295.98. This confirms the Botslab as the linkable row for outside-view parking coverage and the N5S as the cabin (rideshare) row with a stated caveat. Separately, ChatGPT described a Botslab 'bundle' with CPL filter and hardwire kit at $229.99; botslab.com lists that bundle at $294.99 today, and $234.99 is the camera alone.
